settings_credits_body:
Memoirs of Technoir — mechanic learning prototype.
Art direction: Figma Memoirs of Technoir.
Engine: Godot 4 (Compatibility).
repair_hint_hand: Drag parts that are free of screws.
dialogue_self_cassette: If I can understand this… maybe they'll believe in me.
panel_ch01_01: That night the desk was quiet. Only a small lamp kept her trembling fingers company.
panel_ch01_02: On the old wood sat a cassette player. It had been silent for a long time.
panel_ch01_03: She was not a great mechanic. Not yet. But she wanted to understand how things work — from the inside.
panel_ch01_04: Slowly, she picked up a screwdriver. The journey began with one small screw.
panel_ch02_01: The next day, Mas Doni gave her a simple test.
panel_ch02_02: "If you can make this fan live again, then we'll talk about engines."
panel_ch02_03: Under daylight, every blade felt like a challenge — and an invitation.
